svg.title: AHB neural network accelerator data path
svg.desc: A simplified data path: FP8 inputs are converted to 16-bit, weights are stored, an 8 by 8 weight-stationary systolic array computes, partial sums are pipelined, and bias and activation produce the output. An AHB register interface controls the blocks.
svg.text: Register map selects the activation mode; reset sequencing and data widths debugged at integration.
Design Compiler, then a layout lab on a provided design
